annotations.text:
PlanPerm visual refresh

Matched to the live app: DM Sans, #0f766e green, #12383c ink, 17px metric radii, 10px buttons, 1.15/3.25/1.35 columns.

Three changes proposed:
1. Replace Fraunces with Newsreader
2. Type-led hero, drop the stock photo
3. Deadline urgency gets its own colour scale
Four marks, each trading on something the product does. Recommendation is Option B — it survives 16px and means "this area is under watch".
